requirements.description: Daily stock returns, prices, share volume, shares outstanding for ILLIQ (eq. 1), SDRET, R100/R100YR and daily EW market/size-portfolio returns; NYSE universe 1963-1997. crsp_202601.dsf covers 1925-12-31 to 2024-12-31 (107.7M rows).

Monthly returns, prices and shares outstanding for the monthly FM cross-sections (Table 2 dependent variable, month-end SIZE, market cap at year-end y-1). crsp_202601.msf covers 1925-12-31 to 2024-12-31.

Point-in-time share code (10/11 ordinary common) and exchange code (1 = NYSE) validity windows for the NYSE universe filter and the 'listed at end of year y-1' criterion. dsfhdr has hshrcd/hexcd with begdat/enddat; dsenames provides namedt/nameendt plus siccd.
Supplementary names/share-class history (shrcd, exchcd, siccd with namedt/nameendt) for universe checks and ticker history.
Delisting codes and delisting returns for the Shumway (1997) treatment: use dlret when available, else assign -30% for dlstcd 500/520/551-573/574/580/584 (footnote 9).
Cash distribution amounts and dates for DIVYLD (sum of annual cash dividends / end-of-year price). distcd 1xxx codes are ordinary cash dividends.

CRSP cap-based size-decile portfolio returns (RSZ_i, i = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10) and the EW market index for Tables 3-4; crsp_202601.msib has monthly decile returns decret1-decret10 plus ewretd/vwretd, 1925-12-31 to 2024-12-31. Decile numbering (1 = smallest) to be verified at runtime against return magnitudes before use.

One-month T-bill rate for monthly excess returns (Tables 4; compounded to annual for Table 3 — the paper specifies the one-year bill yield 'as of the beginning of year y' for the annual model, but no one-year T-bill yield series exists in the catalog; the one-month bill compounded annually is the documented substitute, logged in assumptions.md). ff.four_factor_monthly.rf covers 1926-07-31 to 2025-10-31; crsp_202601.mcti.t30ret (30-day T-bill monthly return, 1925-2024) is the equivalent backup covering all of 1963.

Daily EW/VW market index returns (backup for the equally-weighted market return used in the Scholes-Williams beta market model and as a cross-check on the NYSE-only EW series computed from dsf). crsp_202601.dsi covers 1925-12-31 to 2024-12-31.
